arabic text: TEDA SEENA NAHI LABDA, BABA MEH RUL GAYAH
english translation text: I CANNOT FIND YOUR CHEST,\nO FATHER! I AM RUINED

arabic text: ENJH LATEH HOY DUR MEDE TEKOO RONA BHUL GAYAH
english translation text: MY EARINGS WERE PULLED SO FORCEFULLY,\nI FORGOT TO CRY FOR YOU

arabic text: BABA MENKOO SHAAM KE LOKA NEH TEDE BAAD KANEEZI WICH MANGIYA, MEH GAIRAT SYEDA DI, OH WELE MARGAY AH
english translation text: AFTER YOU O FATHER! THE PEOPLE OF SHAAM WANTED ME AS THEIR SLAVE,\nI AM THE DIGNITY OF THE AHLULBAYT (A.S),\nI FELT AS THOUGH I HAVE DIED

arabic text: JADAN GAL TENDE ZARBA CHALIYA MEH KOL KOLOH KE DEHNNDI RAY, NAYI MILIYA SAR TEDA, TARLE KARDI RAY AH
english translation text:
WHEN YOUR NECK WAS BEING SEVERED,
I WAS STANDING NEARBY WATCHING,
I DID NOT FIND YOUR HEAD,
EVEN THOUGH I WAS BEGGING FOR IT

arabic text: JADAN WAKHRI QAID DA HUQAM HOYA, MEKOO KALEYA TANG ZINDAAN DEH WICH, INJH RONDI MEH TUREE AH, OH QAIDEN MEH RULGAY AH
english translation text: THE ORDER CAME TO PUT ME INTO SOLITARY CONFINEMENT,\nI WAS LEFT ALONE IN A PRISON,\nI LEFT THE WORLD CRYING FOR YOU

arabic text: DITHA PEHLA PURSA MAQTAL WICH MEKOO SHIMR LAIEEN YATEEMI DA, INJH ZALIM HATH CHAYA, OH MEH KHAAKH TEH JHAN PAYA
english translation text: THE FIRST TIME I MOURNED FOR YOU IN THE BATTLEFIELD,\nACCURSED SHIMR LAID HIS HAND ON ME IN SUCH A WAY THAT I FELL TO THE GROUND
